By continuously optimizing campaign performance and leveraging the latest digital marketing strategies, the Performance Marketing Executive helps accelerate e Commerce growth, deliver measurable business results, and support long-term business success.

Familiarity with Looker Studio, Microsoft Clarity, Hotjar, or similar analytics tools is an added advantage. What We Offer: Competitive salary Flexible working hours 5-day work week
